```{=html}
<div class="classifier-diagram" aria-label="Six-stage classification pipeline, prompt controls, and analytical sample rules">
  <div class="classifier-stages">
    <div class="classifier-stage">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">1</span><h3>News corpus</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">Collect articles<br>Preprocess text<br>Retain source + date</div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-note">Domestic and international sources</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">2</span><h3>Translation</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">Title and body<br>English text<br>Check usable input</div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-note">Full supplied text</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage classifier-stage-focus">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">3</span><h3>Civic classifiers</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-encoder">Civic-event type</div>
      <div class="classifier-encoder">Civic relevance</div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-note">Two encoder models<br>Both filters required</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage classifier-stage-focus">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">4</span><h3>GenAI coding</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">One article / request<br>Action + entities<br>Labels + evidence</div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-note">Batch API</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">5</span><h3>Checks</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">JSON + exact spans<br>Verified storage<br>Check codability</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">6</span><h3>Analytical views</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">Government-month<br>Outlet, actor, action<br>Shares, net and P</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="classifier-process-notes">
    <div class="classifier-note-column">
      <h3>Prompt controls</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>Choose government and primary action before assigning labels</li>
        <li>Fix the complete prompt and track input and model versions</li>
        <li>Preserve allegations and exact evidence for nonzero reputation and framing</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-note-column">
      <h3>Analytical sample</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>Identified government and primary action</li>
        <li>All three labels codable for joint comparisons</li>
        <li>Zeros retained, with nulls and exclusions reported separately</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="classifier-validity-note">Mechanical checks do not establish semantic accuracy.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
